target.title: Agent loop converts tool exceptions into model-visible tool results
target.test: A throwing tool call must not reject the whole turn; it must produce a tool output item containing the error.

steps.instruction: Patch the agent loop tool execution path so registry.execute exceptions are caught per tool call.
steps.expected: executeToolCalls returns a tool output item for failed tools and continues processing later calls.

steps.instruction: Run a focused Node regression that registers a throwing task tool and invokes executeToolCalls.
steps.expected: The process exits 0 and prints a tool output containing an error object instead of throwing.

target.passCriteria: Tool execution failures are represented as model-visible tool outputs.

target.instruction: Patch the agent loop tool execution path so registry.execute exceptions are caught per tool call.
target.expected: executeToolCalls returns a tool output item for failed tools and continues processing later calls.

steps.descript: executeToolCall now wraps registry.execute through executeRegistryTool and returns JSON error output for non-abort exceptions.
evidence: packages/ndx/src/agent/loop/tool-execution.ts catches registry.execute errors, calls throwIfAborted(options.signal), and returns { error: { tool, message } } JSON.

target.instruction: Run a focused Node regression that registers a throwing task tool and invokes executeToolCalls.
target.expected: The process exits 0 and prints a tool output containing an error object instead of throwing.

steps.descript: The focused regression returns a function_call_output item and a tool_result event instead of throwing.
evidence: Regression output contained call_id call-regression and JSON error.tool read_mcp_resource.
Regression tool_result event output contained the MCP server local missing-resource message.

result.descript: Tool execution failures are now model-visible tool outputs.
evidence: Focused regression produced function_call_output with the original missing-resource message.
